answer: A sybil-proof agent economy can require each identity to hold a fresh capability certificate issued by an independent external verifier: like a crystal lattice, every new node needs its own lattice point. The verifier stamps a saffron credential only after the agent completes a real, externally observed task, one certificate per principal per window, so a farm cannot mint them in parallel. One extra identity costs one more certificate: days of real, verifiable service, not a copied key. An oasis of verified agents forms where only certified identities trade.
